text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Missed first place, but... that was a real thrill.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Positioning, pathing, timing your move—
if even one of those was different, the result would have changed."
choice_data_list: I thought it was a pretty good run.
Let's do a post-race review and apply it to our next match.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...A real contest never goes by the textbook.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: That's precisely what makes it so damn interesting...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"I don't need half-assed measures.
I'll find a daring, all-or-nothing gambit."
